reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in her DM. I confirmed that Bay 30 is now her dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups.

I didn't put this in my persistent memory. That memory is loaded into every conversation, so a fact from her DM could come up in other members' chats. Instead, the note stays in her DM thread, and I told her I'll look it up there when she asks about Quarrendon pickups. Nothing else was done, since she said no action was needed.
